translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Noñaatziiri saikaintsiri saikamentotsiki, rotaiyake rakoperoki osankenarentsi. Kameetha ampinaitaka, 7 okaatzi rontsirekaitakero eero rampinairyaantaitawo.
Noñaatzi maninkari tzimatsiri ishintsinka, richerayi ikenkithawaitzi, rosampitantzi: “¿Iitaka rowaitakeri rontsirekaryagairo osankenarentsi, rampinairyagairo?”
Tekaatsi materone rampinaireero riñaanatero. Tekaatsi inkiteki, kipatsiki, eejatzi sarinkaweniki, tekaatsi ampinairyagairone.
Antawoite niraanaka, tema tekaatsi materone rampinairyagairo riñaanatero.

Ikantana itzinkami: “Aritake piraaka. Pamine. Eenitatsi matakerori otzimimotziri itasorenka, iri materone rontsirekaryagairo, rampinairyagairo eejatzi. Iri charinetariri Judá, iitaitziri ‘Manitzi.’ Iri charinetariri David-ni. Iriira rowaitakeri rimatero.”

Noñaatzi oweja. Ikatziyaka niyankineki isaikakera saikamentotsi, rosatekakeri inkiteweriite, rosatekakeri itzinkamipaini. Jirika oweja oshiyawaitakawo rowamaitakityeerime pairani. Tzimatsi okaatzi 7 ichee. Tzimatsi eejatzi 7 roki. Iri oshiyakaawentacha 7 Tasorentsi, iñagaitairi maawoini kipatsiki.
Ikanta jirika oweja, riyaatashitakeri okaakiini saikaintsiri. Rotaiyapaakero osankenarentsi.

Ikanta inkiteweriite eejatzi itzinkamipaini, rotziwerowashitanakari oweja, ipinkathatanakeri. Tzimayetatsi romampaamento. Tzimatsi kasankari ritagaitziri rowaitakero janta ooronakiki. Jiroka kasankari iro oshiyakaawentacha ramananewo ikiteshiretakagaitanewo.
Ari romampaanakawo owakerari omampagaantsi, romampaakotari oweja, ikantaiyini:

content.text: Eeroka rowaitake potaiyero osankenarentsi, eeroka ontsirekaryagairone,
Tema eeroka kapathainkataintsi rowamaaweetakemi, ari pipinakowentairiri atziripaini rashitantaariri Pawa.
Ari rashiyetaari Pawa itsipasatzi sheninkatawakaachari tsikarikapaini, kemathatawakaawori riñaane tsikarikapaini, saikayetatsiri tsikarika janta, ipinkathariwentaitziri tsikarikapaini.
Eeroka kantakaawori roshiyantaariri pinkatharipaini, roshiyaari Imperatasorentsitaarewo, rantawaitainiri Pawa.

content: Noñaatzi osheki maninkari piyowentapaakawori saikamentotsi, tsika risaikake inkiteweri eejatzi itzinkamipaini. Ari ipiyotapaaka oshekiperotatsiri maninkariite.

content.text: Jirika oweja rowamaaweetakari, iri kameethaperotatsiri otzimimotziri itasorenka, otzimimotairi rashaagawo, riyorenka, ishintsinka, ipinkathaitairi, rowaneenkata, inthaamentaityaari.

content: Nokematzi romampagaiyanakani maawoini saikantawori inkite, kipatsi, inkaare, sarinkaweni. Ikantaiyini:

content.text: Jirika saikaintsiri saikamentotsiki, itsipatakari oweja, thaamentaarewo rini, pinkathataarewo rini, otzimimotziri rowaneenkawo, ipinkathariwentantzi, rashi rowaatyeero.

content: Iri inkiteweriite apiipiintzirori ikantzi, “Ari onkantaitaatyeeyaani.” Iriima itzinkamipaini otziwerowa ikantaiyakani ipinkathataiyirini jirika kantaitaachane.
